<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>IONECENTER — Admin Login</title>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Cairo:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest"></script>
    <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="../assets/logo.png">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="admin.css">
</head>
<body class="login-page">
    
    <!-- Background Image -->
    <div class="bg-image" style="background-image: url('../assets/bg-login.jpg');"></div>
    <div class="bg-overlay"></div>

    <main class="login-container">
        
        <div class="login-logo">
            <img src="../assets/logo.png" alt="IONE CENTER">
        </div>

        <h1 class="login-title">Admin Panel</h1>
        <p class="login-subtitle">لوحة إدارة IONECENTER</p>

        <form class="login-form" id="loginForm">
            
            <div class="form-group">
                <label for="password">كلمة المرور</label>
                <div class="input-wrapper">
                    <input 
                        type="password" 
                        id="password" 
                        placeholder="أدخل كلمة المرور"
                        required
                    >
                    <button type="button" class="toggle-password" id="togglePassword">
                        <i data-lucide="eye"></i>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <button type="submit" class="login-btn" id="loginBtn">
                <i data-lucide="log-in"></i>
                <span>تسجيل الدخول</span>
            </button>

            <p class="form-message" id="formMessage"></p>

        </form>

        <footer class="login-footer">
            <p>© 2026 IONE CENTER</p>
        </footer>

    </main>

    <script src="admin.js"></script>
    <script>
        if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

6️⃣ احفظ (Ctrl + S)

css
Copy

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
/*  Background Image (Login Page)                              */
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.bg-image {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    z-index: -2;
    transition: opacity 0.6s ease;
}

.bg-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        rgba(29, 29, 31, 0.75) 0%,
        rgba(227, 30, 36, 0.55) 100%
    );
    z-index: -1;
    backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
}

/* Update login container for better contrast on image */
.login-page .login-container {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    box-shadow: 0 32px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
}

/* Remove old blobs in login page */
.login-page .blobs {
    display: none;
}

4️⃣ احفظ (Ctrl + S)
